title: Context-Aware Interleaved Batching for WhisperX
abstract: arXiv:2608.31170v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: While WhisperX accelerates speech transcription via intra-audio batching, it isolates audio segments, losing the historical context needed for coherent punctuation and terminology transcription. Conversely, standard Whisper retains context sequentially but suffers from slow inference and hallucination loops. To achieve the best of both worlds, we propose Context-Aware Interleaved Batching. By using VAD-derived segment boundaries, our algorithm stabilizes Whisper's text conditioning, allowing us to safely maintain continuous historical context across batched audio segments. As demonstrated on long-form audio benchmarks, this approach reduces Word Error Rate (WER) and improves proper noun transcription, all while maintaining high-throughput inference speeds.

translated_title: 面向WhisperX的上下文感知交错批处理
translated_abstract: 虽然WhisperX通过音频内批处理加速了语音转录，但它将音频片段隔离开来，丢失了连贯标点和术语转录所需的历史上下文。相反，标准Whisper能够按顺序保留上下文，但存在推理速度慢和幻觉循环的问题。为了兼得两者的优势，我们提出了上下文感知交错批处理方法。通过使用由语音活动检测（VAD）导出的片段边界，我们的算法稳定了Whisper的文本条件化，使我们能够在批处理的音频片段之间安全地保持连续的历史上下文。正如在长音频基准测试中所展示的，这种方法降低了词错误率（WER），改善了专有名词的转录，同时保持了高吞吐量的推理速度。
tldr: 提出上下文感知交错批处理方法，利用VAD片段边界在批处理音频片段间保持连续历史上下文，在保持高吞吐量推理速度的同时降低了词错误率并改善了专有名词转录。
en_tdlr: Proposes Context-Aware Interleaved Batching that maintains continuous historical context across batched audio segments using VAD-derived boundaries, reducing Word Error Rate and improving proper noun transcription while preserving high-throughput inference speeds.
